title: 第3章 第一次给了主播第4章 问神
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
与此同时，直播间的名字，也被他直接修改成了：
【扮演雷祖，欢迎各位仙人继续指路。
很快，直播间的网友们，都收到了直播间改名的提示！
评论区也直接炸开了锅。
【卧槽，主播这也太听劝了吧，说让演啥就演啥！
【真假的啊？主播真要扮神啊？】
【第一次播就有这么好的数据，自然要抓住流量密码啊。
【这还是我关注的第一个扮神区的主播，扶额.jpg】
林楠道：“看到刚刚那位水友发的图片，我都怀疑我妈在怀我的时候，是不是天天去拜雷祖了。”
“不过虽说我也觉得自己长得有那么点像，但是我还是第一次做这种扮演，大家认为怎么样才最贴近雷祖的形象呢？我是不是要去搞点装备什么的？”
随着直播间名字的修改，林楠的直播间，也被推荐给了有相关信仰的网友们。
直播间的观看人数，也迅速窜到了三百多人。
一个新人主播，第一次直播能有这样的成绩，已经算是非常不错了！
然而随着这些人的进入，直播间里调侃的氛围，却充斥起了一些怀疑的声音。
【雷祖是所有雷神的掌管者，一个普通人怎么可能扮演雷祖？劝主播不要亵渎神灵！
【这是给我推了个什么显眼包？扮神都是要提前问神同不同意的，你问了吗？小心作茧自缚，捞不着好！
【现在这些主播为了流量什么都不管了，连神仙都要扮，也不怕触怒了神。
紧接着系统收录的建议面板，便有了相应的更新。
【扮演神明：雷祖
难度：中

扮演条件：未知
扮演完成度：0%
收到扮演建议：不要亵渎神灵、询问雷祖是否同意
完成奖励：未获得任何奖励。
一直盯着评论区的林楠，看见这些评论，并没有表现出什么负面情绪。
好的坏的评论他全都照单全收。
只是对于系统收录的建议，林楠却觉得有些离谱。
怎么什么建议都收啊？
林楠开口道：
“谢谢这位水友提出的建议，你放心，我会在扮演之前去询问神明意见的。”
“届时也会开启直播，让大家看到请示的过程，绝对不会亵渎神灵。”
content_en:
At the same time, the name of the live broadcast room was directly changed by him to:
[Playing as Lei Zu, welcome all the immortals to continue to guide you.
Soon, netizens in the live broadcast room all received prompts to change the name of the live broadcast room!
The comment area also exploded.
[Damn it, the anchor is just too persuasive. He just does whatever he is asked to do!
【Is it true or false? Does the anchor really want to pretend to be a god? 】
[The first broadcast has such good data, so naturally we need to grasp the traffic password.
[This is the first anchor who plays the God Zone that I follow, Fu’e.jpg]
Lin Nan said: "Seeing the picture that water friend just sent, I even doubted whether my mother went to worship Lei Zu every day when she was pregnant with me."
"But although I think I look a bit similar, this is my first time doing this kind of role-playing. What do you think is the best way to get the image of Lei Zu? Should I get some equipment or something?"
With the change of the name of the live broadcast room, Lin Nan's live broadcast room has also been recommended to netizens with related beliefs.
The number of viewers in the live broadcast room quickly increased to more than 300 people.
For a new anchor to achieve such results in his first live broadcast, it is already very good!
However, as these people entered, the joking atmosphere in the live broadcast room was filled with some doubtful voices.
[Leizu is the person in charge of all thunder gods. How can an ordinary person play Leizu? I advise the anchor not to blaspheme!
[What kind of conspicuous bag is this for me? When pretending to be a god, you have to ask the god in advance whether he agrees or not. Have you asked? Be careful to trap yourself in a cocoon, as you won’t be able to catch anything!
[Nowadays, these anchors don’t care about anything for the sake of traffic. They even pretend to be gods, and they are not afraid of offending gods.
Immediately afterwards, the suggestion panel included in the system was updated accordingly.
[Playing God: Lei Zu
Difficulty: Medium
Playing Conditions: Unknown
Role play completion: 0%
Received role-playing suggestions: Don’t blaspheme, ask Lei Zu if he agrees
Completion Rewards: No rewards were obtained.
Lin Nan, who had been staring at the comment area, didn't show any negative emotions when he saw these comments.
He accepted all the good and bad comments.
However, Lin Nan felt that the suggestions included in the system were a bit outrageous.
Why do you accept any suggestions?
Lin Nan said:
"Thank you for the suggestion from this water friend. Don't worry, I will ask the gods for their opinions before acting."
"The live broadcast will also be started at that time, so that everyone can see the process of requesting instructions, and it will never be blasphemous."
